_meta.scope: Unmodeled abilities present in curated shipped teams or the Champions mega registry.
_meta.note: As of this snapshot the curated-team + mega ability inventory has engine coverage. Pressure and Frisk are explicit current-sim no-ops because PP drain and hidden item reveal do not affect the current battle math.

Regenerator.why: Pokemon Showdown metadata says Regenerator restores one third max HP on switch-out. The current sim has pivot/switch paths, but this heal is not modeled yet, so teams using Amoonguss must keep this as an explicit mechanics gap until switch-out healing evidence exists.
